meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Manus-style file-based planning for complex tasks. Creates and maintains task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md under .kiro/plan/. Use when planning, breaking down work, resuming a multi-step task, tracking phases, or restoring context after compaction. Trigger phrases include start planning, continue task, resume work, current phase, restore context.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文件管理复杂任务的分步计划与进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需分步骤完成复杂工作并记录进展
copy.tagline_en: Manage complex task plans and progress with files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to break down complex work into steps and track progress

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会为复杂任务创建并维护三个文件：task_plan.md（任务计划）、findings.md（研究发现）和 progress.md（进度日志），并每次回复末尾添加提醒，要求先读取这些文件再继续。
howto.when: 当你要求开始规划、继续任务、恢复工作、询问当前阶段或恢复上下文时触发。也适用于多步骤任务、研究、重构等需要多次工具调用的场景。

say.text: 开始规划这个项目，先创建 task_plan.md。
say.note: Claude 会创建计划文件并开始分解任务。

say.text: 继续之前的任务，恢复上下文。
say.note: Claude 会读取计划文件并继续执行。

say.text: 当前进度如何？检查 task_plan.md。
say.note: Claude 会读取进度文件并汇报状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates and maintains three files for complex tasks: task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md. It appends a reminder at the end of each reply to read these files before proceeding.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to start planning, continue a task, resume work, check the current phase, or restore context. Also suitable for multi-step tasks, research, refactoring, and anything spanning many tool calls.

say_en.text: Start planning this project, create task_plan.md first.
say_en.note: Claude will create the plan file and begin breaking down the task.

say_en.text: Continue the previous task, restore context.
say_en.note: Claude will read the plan files and resume execution.

say_en.text: What is the current progress? Check task_plan.md.
say_en.note: Claude will read the progress file and report status.
